discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its role in glucose regulation, leading to GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology underpins one of the most transformative drug classes in decades (semaglutide, tirzepatide), with huge clinical impact on diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular outcomes; Habener, Mojsov and Drucker received the 2024 Lasker Award and several other major prizes, a common precursor pattern for the Nobel.
